item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: Panel at IPC20 - Unfolding Learner Discourse: How Do We Explain What Learners Say?
item.description: The development of an additional language has occupied many researchers in the field of second language acquisition (SLA). While this field is well established, attention has primarily been given to the acquisition of grammar and vocabulary, and less so to other components of communicative competence, such as pragmatics. Nevertheless, within the domain of pragmatics, a great deal of attention has been given to the pragmatic competence of learners of a language in comparison with native speakers.

item.description: The Department of Linguistics at UC Davis invites abstracts for the fifth North American Conference in Iranian Linguistics (NACIL 5). We welcome original research on any aspect of Iranian languages, from any theoretical or methodological perspective.
